description: Gate-style display at Abbotsford International Airport, painted in 409 Squadron markings. Sources note the airframe was not carrying 101035 while in service, so the displayed serial may be a re-mark; c/n 541 is reported. Listed by Wikipedia's surviving Voodoo article and by Harold Skaarup's British Columbia survivor page.
museum_name: Abbotsford International Airport CF-101 Voodoo, Abbotsford
